This comes after Celestica raised $3 billion by selling new shares, which initially caused a 13% stock drop due to dilution concerns. The author argues that the capital raise, despite initial market apprehension, is a strategic move enabling Celestica to fund crucial AI capacity expansion, making the stock's dip a potential entry point for investors.

events.title: Emerging Growth Research Issues Updated Press Release Announcing Company-Sponsored Research on Virtuix Holdings Inc.

The update clarifies the sponsored nature of the research and provides additional disclosure about EGR's financial relationship with Virtuix. The report reviews Virtuix's strong Q1 2027 performance, highlighting increased Omni One orders, improved gross margin, and expansion in consumer, defense, enterprise, and healthcare markets.

events.title: VST Stock Underperforms Industry in the Past 6 Months: Buy or Hold?
events.summary: Vistra Corp. (VST) has underperformed its industry and the broader utilities sector over the past six months, with shares declining 15.6%. Despite this, the company is making strategic investments in retail operations, renewable generation, and energy storage, and analysts are evaluating if its current discounted valuation and strong return on equity make it an attractive holding, especially given its focus on long-term power purchase agreements and capital deployment strategy. However, declining earnings estimates and exposure to competitive electricity pricing pose challenges.

events.title: Harvard Is Selling a $699 Course Taught by A.I. Clones of Its Faculty
events.summary: Harvard Business School has launched "H.B.S. Foundry," an eight-week entrepreneurship boot camp that costs $699 and features A.I. clones of its faculty. This new offering aims to scale the school's educational reach beyond its traditional M.B.A. program, utilizing A.I. avatars for interactive pitch simulations and personalized guidance. The program has been tested with over 100 universities and has shown that participants prefer and trust A.I. instructions based on specific individuals.

events.title: Stock Traders Purchase High Volume of Direxion Daily META Bull 2X Shares Call Options (NASDAQ:METU)
events.summary: Stock traders recently showed significant interest in Direxion Daily META Bull 2X Shares (NASDAQ:METU), purchasing 11,700 call options, marking a 55% increase over typical daily volume. events.title: What Is Going on With Meta Platforms Stock on Wednesday?
events.summary: Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) stock rose over 2% on Wednesday following news of a multi-billion dollar settlement with U.S. states regarding child safety concerns. The agreement, totaling up to $17 billion, will require Meta to implement new youth safety measures on Facebook and Instagram, including daily usage limits and stronger age verification. This settlement resolves a federal trial but Meta still faces other related litigation.

events.title: Did Record Margins and a US$10 Billion Buyback Expansion Just Shift Phillips 66's (PSX) Investment Narrative?
events.summary: Phillips 66 reported strong Q2 results driven by record refining margins due to global supply disruptions, announcing plans for high refinery utilization and a US$10 billion share buyback expansion. This has amplified the company's focus on returning capital to shareholders and improving its balance sheet, although the sustainability of current refining margins remains a key risk. The article explores how these developments influence PSX's investment narrative and future outlook, contrasting optimistic views with more cautious analyst expectations.

events.title: Tower Health Wins Appeal Over Sharing Patients’ Data With Meta
events.summary: Tower Health has won an appeal against a proposed class action lawsuit that alleged it shared patients' sensitive data with Meta Platforms Inc. without consent. The Third Circuit Court of Appeals upheld the district court's dismissal of the complaint, noting the plaintiffs did not request leave to amend before the dismissal. This decision confirms that the plaintiffs' allegations were deemed deficient.

events.title: Meta's $17 billion settlement mandates new safeguards for kids—many are promising, says safety expert
events.summary: Meta has reached a $17 billion settlement with 52 attorneys general over allegations that its products harmed and addicted children. The settlement mandates new safeguards and parental controls for users under 18 on Facebook and Instagram, including daily time limits, "night mode," and the removal of like statistics. A safety expert views many of these new features as promising for creating a safer online experience for young users.

events.title: Alabama Power promises data center protections, but its proposed rate structure redacts them
events.summary: Alabama Power is redacting critical information in its proposed rate structures for data centers, making it impossible for the public and regulators to verify promised customer protections. Despite claims that contracts with data centers protect other ratepayers through long terms and minimum billing, the actual rate schedule omits these specifics and redacts key financial details. This lack of transparency contrasts with disclosures made by parent company Southern Company to investors and public practices in other states, raising concerns about potential cost shifts to consumers.

events.title: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) Beats On Q4 Sales, Is It Still 14% Below Fair Value?
events.summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) reported better-than-expected Q4 results, showing strong sales and an improved backlog. Despite a recent share price slide, the company is considered 13.6% undervalued with a fair value of $212 per share, driven by its leadership in financial transaction processing, recurring revenue, and margin resilience. However, the report also notes potential risks from softer event-driven revenues and longer sales cycles.

events.title: Is New AI Army Cyber Deal Reshaping The Investment Case For Leidos Holdings (LDOS)?
events.summary: Leidos Holdings recently secured a US$301 million Army cyber defense contract and a US$56 million Naval Health Research Center award, reinforcing its role in integrating AI-enabled cyber defense and behavioral health support for the military. These wins align with Leidos' strategy to focus on higher-margin, software-heavy federal work driven by AI, contributing to projected revenues of $20.7 billion and earnings of $1.6 billion by 2029. While these contracts strengthen the investment thesis, investors should remain aware of the company's significant reliance on U.S. government funding and the competitive landscape for AI-enabled defense contracts.

events.title: Uber (UBER)’s $966 Million Fine: A Temporary Headwind or Bigger Regulatory Threat?
events.summary: Uber is facing a significant regulatory challenge after the Dutch Data Protection Authority fined the company €825 million ($966 million) for using automated systems to suspend drivers without adequate oversight. While Uber plans to appeal, arguing the penalty is disproportionate and based on historical practices, the case highlights increasing regulatory scrutiny on algorithm-driven business models. The long-term impact hinges on whether Uber can reduce the fine and adapt its systems to meet evolving regulatory demands for human oversight.

events.title: J.P. Morgan Keeps Their Hold Rating on Meta Platforms (META)
events.summary: J.P. Morgan analyst Doug Anmuth maintained a Hold rating on Meta Platforms (META) with a $640.00 price target. This rating comes despite other analysts offering varying recommendations, with Needham also issuing a Hold and KeyBanc maintaining a Buy rating on the stock. Meta Platforms reported quarterly revenue of $60.8 billion and a net profit of $15.85 billion for the quarter ending June 30.

events.title: Analysts Are Bullish on Top Communication Services Stocks: Meta Platforms (META), Take-Two (TTWO)
events.summary: Two analysts have issued bullish reports on major Communication Services stocks. Justin Post from Bank of America Securities reiterated a Buy rating for Meta Platforms (META), projecting a 30% upside. Doug Creutz from TD Cowen also maintained a Buy rating for Take-Two (TTWO), with a target price indicating a 25% upside.

events.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Faces Fresh Regulatory Scrutiny, Is It Still Below Fair Value?
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) is facing renewed regulatory scrutiny, including debates over capital rules, an SEC probe, and legal challenges. Despite recent stock performance and a diversified business model, concerns about tighter capital rules and fintech competition persist. While a narrative suggests JPM is 4.3% undervalued, trading at a P/E of 14.9x suggests less obvious room for re-rating compared to industry averages.

events.title: J.P. Morgan Keeps Their Hold Rating on Meta Platforms (META)
events.summary: J.P. Morgan maintained a Hold rating on Meta Platforms (META) with a price target of $640.00, according to analyst Doug Anmuth. Corporate insider sentiment is neutral, with CFO SUSAN J LI recently purchasing 4,288 shares.

events.title: Broadcom (AVGO) Nears $70B Debt Financing Deal, Sources Say
events.summary: Broadcom (AVGO) is reportedly close to securing $70 billion to $80 billion in debt financing for a chip deal to support AI companies like Anthropic, with figures potentially reaching $100 billion. The deal, involving firms like Blackstone and Apollo Global Management, would expand a previous partnership aimed at building AI computing infrastructure. While this strengthens Broadcom's position in the AI sector by diversifying demand and utilizing an off-balance-sheet financing structure, there's a risk if customers default, as Broadcom guarantees part of the debt.

events.title: Arch Capital Group (ACGL) Stock Looks Reasonable As Its 164% Run Holds
events.summary: Arch Capital Group (ACGL) stock has shown strong performance over the past five years, with a 163.6% return, and is currently deemed attractively priced. The company's P/E ratio of 7.2x is below both the insurance industry average (11.3x) and its estimated fair P/E of 10.0x, suggesting it is undervalued. The article emphasizes that Arch Capital Group's valuation appears cheap on earnings and broader checks, highlighting the importance of maintaining underwriting discipline and pricing power for future market confidence.

events.title: What CoStar Group (CSGP)'s Appointment of Ten-X President Steve Price Means For Shareholders
events.summary: CoStar Group (CSGP) has appointed Steve Price as President of Ten-X, its commercial real estate auction platform. Price's experience from Auction.com is expected to enhance efficiency and operations at Ten-X, potentially influencing CoStar's investment narrative, particularly concerning monetization and margin improvement. However, the immediate focus remains on investments in Homes.com, with potential risks if new ventures underperform.

events.title: Tougher U.S. Solar Rules And Incentives Might Change The Case For Investing In First Solar (FSLR)
events.summary: First Solar has recently benefited from strengthened U.S. policy incentives and tighter restrictions on foreign entities, enhancing demand for domestically produced solar modules. This policy shift has improved First Solar's competitive position and could lead to stronger long-term contract terms and pricing power. While the company's 2026 guidance remains strong, the sustainability of its volumes and margins hinges on the continued support of this policy backdrop.

events.title: Key facts: Meta (META) Q1 Data‑Center Lessee; Launches School Mode
events.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. (META) was a significant corporate lessee in data center commitments during Q1 2026, contributing to an aggregate lease total exceeding $850 billion. Additionally, Meta launched "School Mode," a feature designed to mute notifications, limit features, and reduce engagement-driven content on its platforms for school-aged users during school hours.

events.title: Netflix Has Fallen More Than 40% 7 Times in Its History. Here's What Happened Next Each Time.
events.summary: Netflix (NFLX) shares have fallen by over 40% on seven occasions throughout its history, including the current downturn. Despite these significant drops, the stock has historically bounced back strongly, averaging a 248% positive return in the subsequent year after each major decline. However, the article suggests that while history rhymes, the current market dynamics, including increased competition and Netflix's shift towards a value stock, mean future performance may differ from past recoveries.

events.title: VST - Vistra Fell 38%. Adjusted EBITDA Rose 31%. Here's the $472 Million Reason They Disagree.
events.summary: Vistra's stock fell 38% despite a 31% rise in Adjusted EBITDA, largely due to a $472 million unrealized loss on hedges in Q2 2026, an accounting entry rather than a real economic event. The author, who initially made an arithmetic error in valuation, re-evaluated Vistra and found it significantly undervalued. The article highlights Vistra's strong contractual agreements with companies like Meta and its strategic acquisitions, positioning it well in the growing electricity demand sector, especially for AI.

events.title: CEG vs. VST: Which Nuclear Utility Stock Stands Out for Investors?
events.summary: This article compares Constellation Energy (CEG) and Vistra Corp. (VST) as investment opportunities in the nuclear utility sector. While both companies are well-positioned to benefit from growing demand for nuclear power, the analysis highlights Vistra's better earnings estimate movements, stronger Return on Equity, cheaper valuation, and healthier net margin, suggesting it currently has an edge over Constellation Energy despite both holding a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). The article details their financial performance, growth projections, generation capacity, and debt levels to support its conclusion.

events.title: Netflix vs. Meta: The Better Media Stock May Surprise You
events.summary: Netflix and Meta both reported strong Q2 2026 revenue, but the market reacted negatively to both stocks. While Netflix shows promise as a steady compounder with expanding margins and significant stock buybacks, Meta is making a substantial $140 billion bet on AI infrastructure, which has impacted its operating margins. The article suggests Netflix might be the calmer investment for steady compounding, despite Meta's potential for higher upside variance.

events.title: Meta reaches $17B settlement over social media addiction claims
events.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. has agreed to a settlement worth up to $17.1 billion with 52 state and territorial attorneys general to resolve claims that its platforms harmed minors through social media addiction. The settlement mandates changes to Facebook and Instagram, including default daily limits for teen users, nighttime access restrictions, and age-assurance measures to remove users under 13. While Meta denies the allegations, the agreement requires court approval and addresses state-law and federal COPPA claims, though it does not fully resolve broader multidistrict litigation from personal injury plaintiffs or school districts.

events.title: Newsflash: Antalpha Platform Holding Company (NASDAQ:ANTA) Analysts Have Been Trimming Their Revenue Forecasts
events.summary: Analysts have significantly cut their revenue forecasts for Antalpha Platform Holding Company (NASDAQ:ANTA) for 2026, lowering estimates from US$67m to US$57m, representing a projected 30% reduction in sales. This downgrade suggests a weaker outlook for the company, with expected annualised revenue decline of 51% through 2026, contrasting sharply with the industry's projected 13% annual growth. The revisions indicate that Antalpha Platform Holding is expected to perform substantially worse than its industry peers.

The company's shares are currently trading at their highest close since January 22nd and have experienced five consecutive weekly and monthly gains.

events.title: Black Hills Stock: A 439 MW Utility With A 3 GW Data Center Pipeline (NYSE:BKH)
events.summary: Black Hills Corporation (BKH) is a utility company with a robust financial plan, supported by a 600 MW data center load from Microsoft and Meta, projected to drive over 10% consolidated EPS growth from 2028 with minimal capital outlay. events.title: Truist Financial Remains a Hold on Gemini Space Station, Inc. Class A (GEMI)
events.summary: Truist Financial analyst Matthew Coad maintained a Hold rating on Gemini Space Station, Inc. Class A (GEMI) with a price target of $4.50. This rating aligns with another Hold from Cantor Fitzgerald, though Citi maintained a Sell rating. The company reported increased revenue but continued GAAP net losses for the quarter ending June 30, and corporate insider sentiment is negative due to increased share sales.

events.title: Meta settlement could clear the way for new AI product launches, Morgan Stanley says
events.summary: Meta's recent $18 billion settlement in a lawsuit concerning its platforms' design features for younger users is seen by some analysts, including Morgan Stanley, as a potential catalyst for the accelerated launch of new AI products. While Morgan Stanley believes that such substantial legal resolutions often precede innovation waves from tech giants, Needham maintains a "hold" rating on Meta stock, citing concerns about the company's "strategy diffusion" across too many different initiatives. The settlement's impact on revenue from teens is expected to be minimal, as they represent only about 1% of Meta's revenue, but the timing of payments coincides with Meta's significant capital expenditures for AI buildout.

events.title: MongoDB Inc Stock (MDB) Moved Down by 12.69% on Sep 2: What Investors Need To Know
events.summary: MongoDB Inc. (MDB) stock fell by 12.69% on September 2nd despite beating Q2 expectations, primarily due to concerns over decelerating revenue growth projections for Q3, which implied a drop from 30% to 21%. Investors also reacted to elevated pre-earnings expectations and increasing infrastructure costs tied to AI development. Despite long-term analyst optimism, these factors led to profit-taking and a valuation reset.

events.title: G20 live updates: Nvidia's Huang pushes for AI infrastructure in every country
events.summary: The G20 Innovation Ministerial focused heavily on AI, with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang advocating for every country to build its own AI infrastructure, calling it a "great equalizer." Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick discussed impending semiconductor tariffs to encourage domestic production and claimed Canada "blew up" trade deals for political reasons, a claim refuted by Alberta Premier Danielle Smith. Other discussions included the public backlash against AI data centers and predictions of significant economic growth from AI by figures like Elon Musk.

events.title: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc Stock (CRWD) Moved Down by 7.14% on Sep 1: Drivers Behind the Movement
events.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (CRWD) stock declined by 7.14% on September 1st due to profit-taking after a strong post-earnings rally and regulatory filings revealing executive share sales. Despite the short-term pullback, analysts suggest the company's core fundamentals remain solid with strong adoption of its Falcon platform and accelerating demand for AI security solutions. The stock faces risks from stretched valuation, substantial insider divestment, and ongoing GAAP profitability drag from R&D investments.

events.title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
events.summary: Adobe has acquired Rilo, an India-based marketing intelligence startup, in a deal that includes licensing and the acquisition of its six-member team. Rilo's technology, which focuses on automating marketing workflows, is expected to enhance Adobe's existing products, particularly for larger customers. This marks Adobe's second acquisition from India, following Rephrase.ai in 2023, as the company continues to bolster its AI-powered marketing capabilities.

events.title: Can Hedging and Long-Term PPAs Strengthen Vistra's Growth?
events.summary: Vistra Corp. is enhancing its earnings visibility and stability through a dual strategy of disciplined hedging and long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs). This approach, which includes significant contracts with Amazon Web Services and Meta, aims to reduce exposure to volatile wholesale power prices and convert more merchant generation into contracted revenues, ensuring more balanced earnings and supporting long-term investments. While Vistra's shares have declined recently, the stock trades at a discount compared to its industry, and its strategy is similar to other utilities like NRG Energy and NextEra Energy.

events.title: 3 Reasons We Love ConocoPhillips (COP)
events.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) has shown strong market performance, rising 15.3% in the past six months, outperforming the S&P 500. events.summary: Reddit Inc. (RDDT) shares rose by 7.78% on September 2nd, driven by a positive re-evaluation from Baird regarding its AI data licensing prospects and strong ad revenue trends. Analysts maintain a Buy rating with an average price target of $217.26, despite some technical indicators suggesting a neutral to sell condition.

events.title: Aurora Innovation Inc Stock (AUR) Closed Up by 7.14% on Sep 2: What Signal Does It Send?
events.summary: Aurora Innovation Inc. (AUR) saw its stock price rise by 7.14% after announcing an upcoming Analyst and Investor Day to detail its scaling efforts in autonomous trucking. events.title: Intel shuts down Israel AI lab
events.summary: Intel is closing its agentic and inference optimization research laboratories in Israel, resulting in 13 layoffs. The company cited organizational considerations based on geographical location for the decision, which is part of a broader streamlining and restructuring program under CEO Lip-Bu Tan. This move is unusual for the industry, as other tech giants are aggressively investing in AI research.

events.title: Fair Isaac Corp Stock (FICO) Closed Down by 16.68% on Sep 4: What Investors Need To Know
events.summary: Fair Isaac Corp (FICO) stock dropped 16.68% after the FHFA directed Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to allow the use of VantageScore 4.0, ending FICO's exclusive mortgage scoring monopoly. This regulatory change creates concerns about market share loss, price compression, and margin pressure for FICO, whose scoring business, particularly mortgage originations, is a core earnings driver. Technical analysis shows a sell signal and oversold conditions, while fundamental analysis highlights the company's financial metrics within the Software & IT Services industry.

events.title: Fortinet Inc Stock (FTNT) Moved Down by 5.25% on Sep 2: Key Drivers Unveiled
events.summary: Fortinet Inc (FTNT) stock dropped 5.25% on September 2, driven by sector-wide weakness in cybersecurity, sparked by Palo Alto Networks' earnings report. Premium valuations, insider selling, and technical breakdowns below key moving averages contributed to profit-taking and accelerated selling pressure. Despite the short-term pullback, Fortinet maintains strong fundamentals, including record operating margins and free cash flow.

events.title: Meta prices Muse Voice Transcribe at $0.18 an hour, with real-time diarization for 20+ speakers: a steal for enterprises?
events.summary: Meta has launched Muse Voice Transcribe, an audio perception model offering real-time streaming transcription, endpoint detection, and speaker diarization for over 20 speakers at a competitive price of $0.18 per hour. While not holding a world record for speaker count, Muse provides a strong combination of high-capacity diarization, low-latency transcription, and multilingual support, positioning it as a significant option for enterprises. The service also demonstrates leading accuracy benchmarks, putting pressure on competitors in the speech-to-text market.

events.title: Broadcom beats expectations as AI labs double down on custom chips
events.summary: Broadcom Inc. exceeded earnings and revenue expectations in its third-quarter financial report, primarily driven by its semiconductor business and increasing demand from AI labs for custom chips. Despite strong performance and optimistic long-term projections for its AI revenue, the company's stock declined due to a conservative forecast for the current quarter which fell short of Wall Street estimates. Broadcom is actively collaborating with major AI players like Google, OpenAI, and Meta, developing specialized processors to support their growing AI infrastructure needs.
